record.field: select a.vbeln as nomor_do, a.erdat, so.vbeln AS sales_order_no, vbkd.inco1 as delivery_method, ks.name1 AS sold_to_name, so.kunnr AS sold_to_code, ksh.name1 AS ship_to_name, a.kunnr AS ship_to_code, b.werks, b.lgort, b.matnr, m.maktx AS product_description, c.vrkme AS sales_order_uom, b.vrkme AS delivery_uom, b.lfimg AS delivery_qty, mara.meins AS base_uom, marm.umrez AS uom_numerator, marm.umren AS uom_denominator, a.ernam from likp a JOIN lips b ON a.vbeln = b.vbeln JOIN vbak so ON b.vgbel = so.vbeln JOIN vbap c ON b.vgbel = c.vbeln AND b.vgpos = c.posnr LEFT JOIN vbkd ON vbkd.vbeln = so.vbeln AND vbkd.posnr = '000000' JOIN kna1 ks ON so.kunnr = ks.kunnr JOIN kna1 ksh ON a.kunnr = ksh.kunnr LEFT JOIN makt m ON b.matnr = m.matnr AND m.spras = 'E' LEFT JOIN mara ON b.matnr = mara.matnr LEFT JOIN marm ON marm.matnr = b.matnr AND marm.meinh = c.vrkme where TO_DATE(a.erdat,'YYYYMMDD') between CURRENT_DATE-30 and CURRENT_DATE

select a.vbeln_vl, a.arrdate, a.trucknr, a.werks, a.lgort, b.kunnr, c.matnr, c.lfimg, c.vrkme, d.umrez, d.umren, b.ernam from zmm_ts_sto a join likp b on a.vbeln_vl=b.vbeln join lips c on b.vbeln=c.vbeln left join marm d on c.matnr=d.matnr and c.vrkme=d.meinh where a.werks='1601' and exists (select 1 from zmm_ts_arr_pool e where e.trucknr=a.trucknr and e.srctab='ZMM_TS_OSTO_NCPL')
